title: Laa cadjin
description: Ten short, simple stories about everyday life on the Isle of Man and nearby.

lessons.title: Yn skeeal ec Kerron
lessons.summary: Kerron writes a story in a big book with a black pen, and Nessa changes one word.
lessons.text:
Ta Kerron Quine cummal ayns Doolish. Ta lioar vooar echey, as ta penn doo echey. Ta Kerron screeu skeeal 'sy lioar lesh y penn doo.

Va Kerron screeu rish mee. Nish, ta 20 duillag 'sy lioar.

Hie Kerron dys thie Nessa Kelly. Ta enney ec Nessa er focklyn, as t'ee screeu lioaryn.

“Shoh my lioar, as shoh my skeeal,” dooyrt Kerron.

Va Nessa fakin ny duillagyn, as va Kerron fakin Nessa.

“Ta'n skeeal mie,” dooyrt Nessa. “Agh cha nel y fockle shoh mie er y ghuillag shoh.”

Ren Nessa ymmyd jeh e penn doo hene, as screeu ee fockle noa er y ghuillag.

“Ta'n fockle noa mie,” dooyrt Kerron. “Ta my skeeal ny share.”

Va Kerron screeu rish mee elley. Ec y jerrey, va'n lioar jeant, as hug Kerron y lioar da Nessa.

Feyshtyn:
Vel penn doo ec Kerron?
Ta. Ta penn doo echey, as ta lioar vooar echey.
Row Kerron screeu rish mee?
Va. Va Kerron screeu skeeal rish mee.
Vel 20 duillag 'sy lioar?
Ta. Ta 20 duillag 'sy lioar.
Ren Nessa screeu fockle noa?
Ren. Screeu ee fockle noa lesh e penn doo.

lessons.title: Ny blaaghyn ec Ailsa
lessons.summary: Ailsa plants flowers and herbs, waters them often, and gives some to an old neighbour.
lessons.text:
Ta thalloo beg ec Ailsa Corlett liorish e thie. Ayns y tourey, ta Ailsa soie blaaghyn as lussyn 'sy thalloo.

Ta Ailsa cur ushtey da ny blaaghyn mennick. Gyn ushtey, cha nel blaa ny lus aase.

Ta ny lussyn aase seose, as ta ny blaaghyn aase seose. Ta Ailsa goll magh dys y thalloo mennick, as t'ee jannoo obbyr ayn. She red mie eh.

Haink ben shenn veih'n thie elley.

“Ta ny blaaghyn ayd mooar,” dooyrt y ven shenn.

“Ta mee cur ushtey daue mennick,” dooyrt Ailsa. “Gyn ushtey, cha nel ny blaaghyn aase.”

Hug Ailsa daa vlaa as lus beg da'n ven shenn. Ren y ven shenn y lus beg y hoie 'sy thalloo eck hene.

“Shoh red mie,” dooyrt y ven shenn. “Ta lus beg ayns my thalloo nish.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel thalloo ec Ailsa?
Ta. Ta thalloo beg eck liorish e thie.
Vel Ailsa cur ushtey da ny blaaghyn?
Ta. T'ee cur ushtey daue mennick.
Vel ny lussyn aase seose?
Ta. Ta ny lussyn as ny blaaghyn aase seose.
Hug Ailsa daa vlaa da'n ven shenn?
Hug. Hug ee daa vlaa as lus beg da'n ven shenn.

lessons.title: Roie er y slyst
lessons.summary: Ewan runs west along the coast from Peel, crosses the river, sees a swimmer and runs back east.
lessons.text:
Ta Ewan Cubbon cummal ayns Pheeil, er y slyst sheear jeh'n ellan. Ta Ewan roie mennick.

Ta Ewan roie veih'n thie echey. Ta'n raad goll trooid y balley, as ta Ewan roie trooid y balley.

Ta awin ayns mean y valley. Ta Ewan goll harrish yn awin, as t'eh roie sheear er y slyst, liorish y vooir.

Ta fer ayns y vooir. Cha nel Ewan fakin agh kione y fer er eaghtyr yn ushtey. Ta'n kione beg, as ta eaghtyr ny marrey mooar.

Ec jerrey y raad, ta Ewan cur e chassyn 'syn ushtey. Ta'n ushtey mie da e chassyn.

Eisht, ta Ewan roie shiar. T'eh goll harrish yn awin reesht, as t'eh roie shiar trooid y balley dys y thie echey.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Ewan cummal er y slyst sheear?
Ta. T'eh cummal ayns Pheeil, er y slyst sheear jeh'n ellan.
Vel Ewan goll harrish yn awin?
Ta. T'eh goll harrish yn awin, as t'eh roie sheear er y slyst.
Vel Ewan fakin fer ayns y vooir?
Ta. T'eh fakin kione y fer er eaghtyr yn ushtey.
Vel Ewan cur e chassyn 'syn ushtey?
Ta. T'eh cur e chassyn 'syn ushtey ec jerrey y raad.

lessons.title: Yn ree mie
lessons.summary: Joney reads an old story about a wise king who would not go to war.
lessons.text:
Ta lioar shenn ec Joney Kinvig. Ta skeeal 'sy lioar mysh ree.

Va ree ayns reeriaght er ellan. Va'n ree ruggit 'sy reeriaght, as va'n pobble mie da'n ree. Va keeall vie ec y ree.

Va ree elley ayns reeriaght elley 'sy jiass. Haink y ree shen dys yn ellan lesh deiney, dy chaggey noi'n ree as noi'n pobble.

Agh va keeall vie ec y ree. Cha ren eh caggey. Ren eh yn ellan y rheynn: hug eh cooid jeh'n thalloo da'n ree elley. Cha row caggey ayn, as va bea vie ec y pobble.

Va bea vie ec y ree. Hooar eh baase as eh shenn. Rere y skeeal, cha row ree elley myr eh 'sy seihll.

“Va keeall vie ec y ree,” dooyrt Joney. “Cha row ree elley myr eh 'sy seihll. Cha mie lhiam caggey. Ta'n skeeal mysh y ree shoh mie.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel skeeal 'sy lioar mysh ree?
Ta. Ta skeeal 'sy lioar mysh ree.
Row'n ree ruggit 'sy reeriaght?
Va. Va'n ree ruggit 'sy reeriaght.
Haink ree elley dy chaggey noi'n pobble?
Haink. Haink eh veih reeriaght elley 'sy jiass.
Ren y ree caggey?
Cha ren. Va keeall vie echey, as ren eh yn ellan y rheynn.

lessons.title: Yn reiltys noa
lessons.summary: Calum chooses for the first time when the island picks a new national government.
lessons.text:
Ta Calum Clague cummal ayns Rhumsaa. T'eh 18 bleeaney d'eash. Ta'n sleih ayns Ellan Vannin reih reiltys ashoonagh noa, as ta Calum reih son y chied cheayrt.

Ta cooishyn mooarey ayn: obbyr, thieyn as raaidyn. Ta Calum screeu ny cooishyn er duillag.

Ta daa phossan 'sy valley. Ta'n chied phossan son thieyn noa. Ta'n possan elley son raaidyn noa. Ta paart jeh'n sleih son y chied phossan, as paart son y possan elley.

Ta corys mie ayns Ellan Vannin. Ta'n sleih reih, as ta'n possan lesh yn earroo smoo stiurey yn ellan.

Hie Calum dys thie mooar 'sy valley, as screeu eh e reih er duillag.

Ec y jerrey, va'n earroo son y chied phossan ny smoo. Ta'n reiltys ashoonagh noa stiurey yn ellan, as ta thieyn noa çheet.

“Ta'n corys shoh mie,” dooyrt Calum. “Ta'n sleih hene reih y reiltys.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel Calum reih son y chied cheayrt?
Ta. Ta Calum reih son y chied cheayrt.
Vel daa phossan 'sy valley?
Ta. Ta'n chied phossan son thieyn noa, as ta'n possan elley son raaidyn noa.
Ren Calum screeu e reih er duillag?
Ren. Screeu eh e reih er duillag.
Vel y reiltys ashoonagh noa stiurey yn ellan?
Ta. Ta'n reiltys noa stiurey yn ellan.

lessons.title: Turrys gys Divlyn
lessons.summary: Niall from Douglas visits Dublin and meets an old woman whose native language is Irish.
lessons.text:
Ta Niall Crellin goll voish Doolish gys Divlyn. Ta Divlyn ayns Pobblaght Nerin. She caayr vooar ee.

Ta kiare queiggey ayns Nerin. Ta Divlyn ayns Queiggey Laighin, 'sy shiar. Ta Nerin Hwoaie ayns y Reeriaght Unnaneysit. Ta paart jeh Queiggey Ulley ayns y Reeriaght Unnaneysit, as paart ayns y Phobblaght.

Ta ymmodee ynnydyn mie ayns y chaayr. Ta Niall goll dys ynnydyn shenn as ynnydyn noa. Ta ymmodee deiney as mraane 'sy chaayr, as ta Niall goll mastey'n sleih.

Mastey'n sleih, ta ben shenn. She Yernish y çhengey ghooie eck. She Gaelg y çhengey ghooie ec Niall. Ta ymmodee focklyn ayns Yernish myr focklyn ayns Gaelg.

“Ta Gaelg as Yernish mie,” dooyrt y ven shenn.

Ec y jerrey, ta Niall goll voish Divlyn gys Doolish.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Niall goll voish Doolish gys Divlyn?
Ta. T'eh goll voish Doolish gys Divlyn.
Vel Divlyn ayns Queiggey Laighin?
Ta. Ta Divlyn ayns Queiggey Laighin, 'sy shiar.
Vel Nerin Hwoaie ayns y Reeriaght Unnaneysit?
Ta. Ta Nerin Hwoaie ayns y Reeriaght Unnaneysit.
Nee Yernish y çhengey ghooie ec y ven shenn?
She. She Yernish y çhengey ghooie eck.

lessons.title: Nollick
lessons.summary: Before Christmas Colin buys gifts for his family, and after Christmas they visit Sile's mother.
lessons.text:
Ta'n geurey er çheet, as ta'n Nollick çheet. Ta tree ayns y lught-thie ec Colin Teare: Colin, e ven Sile, as Conor, y mac oc.

Dagh geurey, roish y Nollick, ta Colin goll dys Doolish, as t'eh geddyn reddyn son y lught-thie. Hooar eh tree lioaryn son Conor, as un red beg son Sile.

Ec y Nollick, ta'n lught-thie ayns y thie. Ta Conor fakin ny tree lioaryn.

“Ta'n lioar shoh mie,” dooyrt Conor, as t'eh goaill un lioar.

She traa mie eh. Ta traa ec Colin son y lught-thie ec y Nollick.

Dagh blein, lurg y Nollick, ta'n lught-thie goll dys y twoaie, dys thie moir Sile. Ta traa mie oc ayns shen.

Yn nah vlein, ta'n lught-thie goll dys Nerin son y Nollick.

Feyshtyn:
Vel tree ayns y lught-thie?
Ta. Ta Colin, Sile as Conor ayns y lught-thie.
Hooar Colin reddyn roish y Nollick?
Hooar. Hooar eh tree lioaryn son Conor, as un red beg son Sile.
Vel y lught-thie goll dys y twoaie lurg y Nollick?
Ta. T'ad goll dys thie moir Sile lurg y Nollick.
Vel y lught-thie goll dys Nerin yn nah vlein?
Ta. Yn nah vlein, t'ad goll dys Nerin son y Nollick.

lessons.title: Yn fouyr
lessons.summary: Donal puts up a sign for harvest workers, and they work around his land until the harvest is in.
lessons.text:
Ta thalloo mooar ec Donal Kneale 'sy twoaie. Car y tourey, ta ram lussyn aase er y thalloo.

Nish, ta'n fouyr er çheet. Ta ram obbyr ayn, ram obbyr son un fer. Ta Donal soie cowrey liorish y raad: “Obbreeyn son y fouyr.”

Haink obbreeyn veih'n balley: mysh 10 obbree. Ta ny obbreeyn goll mygeayrt y thalloo, as t'ad jannoo obbyr derrey jerrey y fouyr.

Car y fouyr, ta Donal cur bee da ny obbreeyn. Ta'n fouyr goll er feie'n ellan. Er feie'n ellan, ta obbreeyn goll mygeayrt ny thallooyn.

Ec jerrey y fouyr, ta Donal goaill y cowrey stiagh 'sy thie.

“Va'n fouyr mie,” dooyrt Donal rish ny obbreeyn. “Bee'n cowrey 'sy thie derrey yn nah fouyr.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel thalloo mooar ec Donal?
Ta. Ta thalloo mooar echey 'sy twoaie.
Ren Donal soie cowrey liorish y raad?
Ren. Ren eh cowrey y hoie liorish y raad.
Haink obbreeyn veih'n balley?
Haink. Haink mysh 10 obbree veih'n balley.
Vel ny obbreeyn jannoo obbyr derrey jerrey y fouyr?
Ta. T'ad goll mygeayrt y thalloo derrey jerrey y fouyr.

lessons.title: Caslys er lheh
lessons.summary: Laura makes a picture of Brian, a hundred-year-old man who still lives in the house where he was born.
lessons.text:
Ta taghyrt er lheh 'sy valley. Ta fer shenn, enmyssit Brian Quilliam, 100 bleeaney d'eash.

Va Brian ruggit 'sy valley, ayns thie beg liorish yn awin. T'eh cummal 'sy thie cheddin.

Ta Laura Cregeen jannoo caslyssyn jeh sleih. Hie Laura dys thie Brian. Ren ee caslys jeh Brian ayns y thie cheddin, liorish yn awin.

Ta'n caslys feer vie.

“Gow y caslys,” dooyrt Laura. “She red ennagh son y taghyrt eh.”

Ghow Brian y caslys.

“Ta red ennagh er lheh ayns y thie shoh,” dooyrt Brian. “Va my vea 'sy thie cheddin.”

“She taghyrt feer vie eh,” dooyrt Laura.

Feyshtyn:
Vel fer enmyssit Brian Quilliam 100 bleeaney d'eash?
Ta. T'eh 100 bleeaney d'eash.
Vel Brian cummal 'sy thie cheddin?
Ta. Va eh ruggit 'sy thie, as t'eh cummal 'sy thie cheddin.
Ren Laura caslys jeh Brian?
Ren. Ren ee caslys jeh Brian ayns y thie.
Ghow Brian y caslys?
Ghow. Ghow eh y caslys, as ta'n caslys feer vie.

lessons.title: Yn boayl noa
lessons.summary: Lewis moves from a big English city to a small Manx village by the sea and likes it.
lessons.text:
Va Lewis Shimmin cummal ayns caayr vooar ayns Sostyn. Nish, t'eh cummal ayns boayl noa: balley beg ayns Ellan Vannin. Haink eh marish e lught-thie.

Ta'n thie noa er y çheu elley jeh'n raad, liorish y vooir. Cha nel agh kuse dy hieyn 'sy valley, as kuse dy chummaltee.

Ta ymmodee reddyn mie 'sy voayl noa: myr sampleyr, y vooir, y slyst as ny blaaghyn. Cha row y lheid ayns y chaayr. Cha nel dy chooilley red mie: myr sampleyr, cha nel scoill 'sy valley.

Haink fer shenn veih'n çheu elley jeh'n raad.

“Nagh vel y boayl shoh mie?” dooyrt y fer shenn.

“Ta,” dooyrt Lewis. “Cha row y lheid ayns Sostyn.”

“Nagh vel oo goll er ash dys y chaayr?”

“Cha nel,” dooyrt Lewis. Hie eh magh marish y fer shenn, as hie ad er y slyst.

Feyshtyn:
Va Lewis cummal ayns caayr vooar ayns Sostyn?
Va. Va Lewis cummal ayns caayr vooar ayns Sostyn.
Haink Lewis marish e lught-thie?
Haink. Haink eh marish e lught-thie.
Vel ymmodee thieyn 'sy valley?
Cha nel. Cha nel agh kuse dy hieyn 'sy valley.
Vel Lewis goll er ash dys y chaayr?
Cha nel. T'eh cummal 'sy voayl noa.
